SENTINEL vendored third-party libraries (Phase 14: no unpinned CDN dependencies)

Both files are unmodified copies of the exact pinned releases previously
loaded from cdn.jsdelivr.net, now served from this directory so the frontend
has no runtime dependency on a third-party CDN.
